posts.body_html: I was a Sarracenia collector many years back before taking a break due to several cross-country moves.  I recently got back into the hobby a year ago, and some of the first plants on my list were some of the most difficult to source.  My thorough searches led me to this forum and, consistently, Mike Wang’s listing.  I was nervous about sending a large sum of money to a person over the internet, but wow, did I end up happy.  Mike’s plants were amazing and far exceeded what was described.  As a trained plant pathologist, I could not believe how incredibly healthy the plants, and especially root systems were.  Packing and shipping were thoughtfully done.  Mike goes above and beyond to make his customers happy, and you can tell that he really loves what he does.  Not only would I buy again, but Mike remains my top source for all Sarracenia (except, unfortunately, the endangered species).
